Each component of every resolved floating-point attribute defined by the applied Omni lens-distortion API shall be finite.

Resolved nominalHeight shall be greater than zero when defined by the applied API.

Resolved cy shall be finite when defined by the applied API.

Resolved fy shall be greater than zero when defined by the applied API.

Kit 110.4 validation shall warn when OmniLensDistortionFthetaAPI, OmniLensDistortionKannalaBrandtK3API, or OmniLensDistortionRadTanThinPrismAPI is applied.
The F-theta polynomial shall be finite over the nominal radial image domain admitted by maxFov.
For every admitted theta, the F-theta polynomial shall have exactly one nonnegative radial root in the nominal radial image domain.
The derivative of the F-theta polynomial shall be nonzero at every root required by CAMERA-LENS-016.
The Kannala-Brandt radial map shall be finite for every theta in [0,maxFov/2].
The derivative of the Kannala-Brandt radial map shall be strictly positive for every theta in [0,maxFov/2].
The RadTan radial map shall be finite for every theta in [0,maxFov/2].
The RadTan radial map shall be strictly increasing on [0,maxFov/2].
Each entry of the renderer's tangential-plus-thin-prism Jacobian shall be finite throughout the normalized calibration image domain.
The determinant of the RadTan Jacobian shall be nonzero throughout the normalized calibration image domain.
The OpenCV fisheye edge equation shall have a finite positive solution theta_edge.
The OpenCV fisheye radial map shall be strictly increasing on [0,theta_edge].
The OpenCV pinhole radial denominator shall be finite throughout the normalized calibration image domain.
The OpenCV pinhole radial denominator shall be nonzero throughout the normalized calibration image domain.
Each entry of the OpenCV pinhole distortion Jacobian shall be finite throughout the normalized calibration image domain.
The determinant of the OpenCV pinhole distortion Jacobian shall be nonzero throughout the normalized calibration image domain.

rayExitPositionTexture shall resolve to a decodable OpenEXR image.

rayExitPositionTexture shall use uncompressed, RLE, ZIPS, ZIP, or PIZ OpenEXR compression.

rayEnterDirectionTexture shall contain a named G channel.

The G channel of rayEnterDirectionTexture shall use the OpenEXR FLOAT (32-bit) pixel type.
The B channel of rayEnterDirectionTexture shall use the OpenEXR FLOAT (32-bit) pixel type.
The R channel of rayExitPositionTexture shall use the OpenEXR FLOAT (32-bit) pixel type.
The G channel of rayExitPositionTexture shall use the OpenEXR FLOAT (32-bit) pixel type.

The decoded height of rayEnterDirectionTexture shall be greater than zero.
The decoded width of rayExitPositionTexture shall be greater than zero.
